items.text: REFERRED TO HOUSING, CONSTRUCTION AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT

items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S5441

 TITLE OF BILL :

An act to amend the private housing finance law, in relation to
limited-profit housing companies in a city with a population of one
million or more


 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :

This bill would amend the Private Housing Finance Law by requiring
municipally-aided Mitchell-Lama projects in a city with a population
of one million or more to post the first and last names of all persons
on each waiting list maintained by such project, in chronological
order, by such project's management office, or, if there is no
management office on the site of such municipally-aided project, in
such project's lobby.

 REASONS FOR SUPPORT :

Under the Private Housing Finance Law, limited-profit housing
companies are responsible for selecting income eligible
tenants/cooperators to occupy the dwelling units in their projects.
Such housing companies maintain external waiting lists for all
tenant/cooperator applications for apartments as well as internal
waiting lists for current tenant/cooperators who want to move to a
different size apartment. These waiting lists generally list such
applications in chronological order, established by date of receipt or
order of selection by lottery, and may be sorted by apartment size. By
requiring these waiting lists to be posted, this amendment to the
Private Housing Finance Law would ensure that prospective applicants
could easily track their progress on such waiting lists.
Concurrently, existing tenant/cooperators on the internal waiting list
would also be better able to keep track of the status of their
applications for internal transfers. By making the waiting list
process more open, corruptive practices can more readily be thwarted.
Furthermore, by limiting such postings to the first and last names of
the waiting list applicants, there would not be any breach of such
applicants' privacy. Given the scarcity of Mitchell-Lama housing, it
is critical that the waiting list process be as open to public
scrutiny as is reasonably possible.

Accordingly, the Mayor urges the earliest possible favorable
consideration of this proposal by the Legislature.

summary: Requires all municipally-aided Mitchell-Lama projects in a city with a population of one million or more to post the names of all persons on each waiting list maintained by such project in the lobby.
title: Requires all municipally-aided Mitchell-Lama projects in N.Y. city to post the names of all persons on each waiting list in the lobby
